# Option Reference

Curb implements 116 `.editorconfig` keys. Every key has a before/after example generated by running Curb.

Use the filter above to search by name. Each group below links to its own index.

## [Core](core/index.md)

- [indent_style](core/indent_style.md) — Indent with spaces or tabs.
- [indent_size](core/indent_size.md) — Columns per indent level.
- [tab_width](core/tab_width.md) — Columns a tab occupies when measuring line width.
- [end_of_line](core/end_of_line.md) — Line ending to write. auto matches whatever the source uses.
- [insert_final_newline](core/insert_final_newline.md) — Ensure the file ends with a newline.
- [trim_trailing_whitespace](core/trim_trailing_whitespace.md) — Remove trailing whitespace from each line.
- [charset](core/charset.md) — Byte-order mark handling. preserve keeps whatever the file arrived with.
- [max_line_length](core/max_line_length.md) — Column target for reflow. off disables reflow entirely and selects preservation mode.

## [New Lines](new-lines/index.md)

- [csharp_new_line_before_open_brace](new-lines/csharp_new_line_before_open_brace.md) — Which constructs put their opening brace on a new line.
- [csharp_new_line_before_else](new-lines/csharp_new_line_before_else.md) — Put else on its own line rather than joining it to the preceding brace.
- [csharp_new_line_before_catch](new-lines/csharp_new_line_before_catch.md) — Put catch on its own line.
- [csharp_new_line_before_finally](new-lines/csharp_new_line_before_finally.md) — Put finally on its own line.
- [csharp_new_line_before_members_in_object_initializers](new-lines/csharp_new_line_before_members_in_object_initializers.md) — Put each member of an object initializer on its own line.
- [csharp_new_line_before_members_in_anonymous_types](new-lines/csharp_new_line_before_members_in_anonymous_types.md) — Put each member of an anonymous type on its own line.
- [csharp_new_line_between_query_expression_clauses](new-lines/csharp_new_line_between_query_expression_clauses.md) — Put each clause of a query expression on its own line.

## [Indentation](indentation/index.md)

- [csharp_indent_case_contents](indentation/csharp_indent_case_contents.md) — Indent statements inside a case label.
- [csharp_indent_switch_labels](indentation/csharp_indent_switch_labels.md) — Indent case labels inside their switch.
- [csharp_indent_labels](indentation/csharp_indent_labels.md) — How goto labels are indented.
- [csharp_indent_block_contents](indentation/csharp_indent_block_contents.md) — Indent statements inside a block.
- [csharp_indent_braces](indentation/csharp_indent_braces.md) — Indent the brace tokens themselves an extra level.
- [csharp_indent_case_contents_when_block](indentation/csharp_indent_case_contents_when_block.md) — Indent a braced case body. csharp_indent_case_contents governs other statements.

- [csharp_space_after_cast](spacing/csharp_space_after_cast.md) — Space between a cast and its operand.
- [csharp_space_after_keywords_in_control_flow_statements](spacing/csharp_space_after_keywords_in_control_flow_statements.md) — Space between a control-flow keyword and its opening parenthesis.
- [csharp_space_before_colon_in_inheritance_clause](spacing/csharp_space_before_colon_in_inheritance_clause.md) — Space before the colon in a base list.
- [csharp_space_after_colon_in_inheritance_clause](spacing/csharp_space_after_colon_in_inheritance_clause.md) — Space after the colon in a base list.
- [csharp_space_around_binary_operators](spacing/csharp_space_around_binary_operators.md) — Spaces around binary and assignment operators.
- [csharp_space_around_declaration_statements](spacing/csharp_space_around_declaration_statements.md) — Extra spaces in declaration statements. false normalises; ignore leaves them alone.
- [csharp_space_after_comma](spacing/csharp_space_after_comma.md) — Space after a comma.
- [csharp_space_before_comma](spacing/csharp_space_before_comma.md) — Space before a comma.
- [csharp_space_between_parentheses](spacing/csharp_space_between_parentheses.md) — Space just inside parentheses for specific constructs.

- [csharp_space_between_method_declaration_name_and_open_parenthesis](spacing/csharp_space_between_method_declaration_name_and_open_parenthesis.md) — Space between the method name and its opening parenthesis.
- [csharp_space_between_method_call_parameter_list_parentheses](spacing/csharp_space_between_method_call_parameter_list_parentheses.md) — Space just inside the parentheses of an argument list.
- [csharp_space_between_method_call_empty_parameter_list_parentheses](spacing/csharp_space_between_method_call_empty_parameter_list_parentheses.md) — Space inside an empty argument list ().
- [csharp_space_between_method_call_name_and_opening_parenthesis](spacing/csharp_space_between_method_call_name_and_opening_parenthesis.md) — Space between the method name and its opening parenthesis at a call site.
- [csharp_space_before_open_square_brackets](spacing/csharp_space_before_open_square_brackets.md) — Space before an opening square bracket.
- [csharp_space_between_empty_square_brackets](spacing/csharp_space_between_empty_square_brackets.md) — Space inside empty square brackets [].
- [csharp_space_between_square_brackets](spacing/csharp_space_between_square_brackets.md) — Space inside non-empty square brackets.
- [csharp_space_before_dot](spacing/csharp_space_before_dot.md) — Space before a dot.
- [csharp_space_after_dot](spacing/csharp_space_after_dot.md) — Space after a dot.
- [csharp_space_before_semicolon_in_for_statement](spacing/csharp_space_before_semicolon_in_for_statement.md) — Space before a semicolon in a for statement.
- [csharp_space_after_semicolon_in_for_statement](spacing/csharp_space_after_semicolon_in_for_statement.md) — Space after a semicolon in a for statement.
- [csharp_space_after_unary_operator](spacing/csharp_space_after_unary_operator.md) — Space after unary minus/plus, logical not, and the unsafe pointer prefix operators. Not bitwise complement or prefix increment/decrement.
- [csharp_space_around_ternary_operator](spacing/csharp_space_around_ternary_operator.md) — Space around the ?/: of a ternary conditional expression.

## [Wrapping](wrapping/index.md)

- [csharp_preserve_single_line_blocks](wrapping/csharp_preserve_single_line_blocks.md) — Allow a block the author wrote on one line to stay on one line.
- [csharp_empty_block_style](wrapping/csharp_empty_block_style.md) — How an empty method, constructor, accessor or control-flow body is laid out. together_same_line keeps { } on the signature's line.
- [csharp_preserve_single_line_statements](wrapping/csharp_preserve_single_line_statements.md) — Allow a control-flow body the author left on its header's line to stay there.
- [csharp_keep_existing_linebreaks](wrapping/csharp_keep_existing_linebreaks.md) — Preservation mode. Defaults to true when max_line_length is off.
- [csharp_wrap_before_first_method_call](wrapping/csharp_wrap_before_first_method_call.md) — When a chain breaks, break before the first call too, leaving the receiver on its own line.
- [csharp_wrap_before_first_type_parameter_constraint](wrapping/csharp_wrap_before_first_type_parameter_constraint.md) — Put a where clause on its own line.
- [csharp_wrap_before_extends_colon](wrapping/csharp_wrap_before_extends_colon.md) — Put a base list on its own line, colon first.
- [csharp_place_constructor_initializer_on_same_line](wrapping/csharp_place_constructor_initializer_on_same_line.md) — Keep : base(...) on the constructor's line rather than giving it its own.
- [csharp_wrap_before_arrow_with_expressions](wrapping/csharp_wrap_before_arrow_with_expressions.md) — When an expression body wraps, put => at the start of the new line.
- [csharp_wrap_after_dot_in_method_calls](wrapping/csharp_wrap_after_dot_in_method_calls.md) — When a chain breaks, leave the dot at the end of the preceding line.
- [csharp_wrap_chained_method_calls](wrapping/csharp_wrap_chained_method_calls.md) — Break a chain of three or more calls onto its own line per call once it does not fit. Curb's default behaviour either way; setting the key only makes it explicit.
- [csharp_place_simple_enum_on_single_line](wrapping/csharp_place_simple_enum_on_single_line.md) — Allow a short enum body to stay on one line.
- [csharp_place_simple_accessorholder_on_single_line](wrapping/csharp_place_simple_accessorholder_on_single_line.md) — Allow { get; set; } to stay on the property's line.
- [csharp_wrap_chained_binary_expressions](wrapping/csharp_wrap_chained_binary_expressions.md) — Break each operand of a long && or || chain onto its own line. chop_always breaks regardless of width; wrap_if_long packs operands instead of breaking every one. Only honoured in deterministic mode (max_line_length set).
- [csharp_wrap_before_binary_opsign](wrapping/csharp_wrap_before_binary_opsign.md) — When a binary chain breaks, start the new line with the operator.
- [csharp_wrap_parameters_style](wrapping/csharp_wrap_parameters_style.md) — chop_always gives every parameter its own line regardless of width; wrap_if_long packs parameters instead. wrap_if_long is only honoured in deterministic mode (max_line_length set) — chop_always and chop_if_long work in either.
- [csharp_wrap_arguments_style](wrapping/csharp_wrap_arguments_style.md) — chop_always gives every argument its own line; wrap_if_long packs arguments instead. Only honoured in deterministic mode (max_line_length set).
- [csharp_wrap_object_and_collection_initializer_style](wrapping/csharp_wrap_object_and_collection_initializer_style.md) — chop_always gives every initializer element its own line. Only honoured in deterministic mode. wrap_if_long is not offered: dotnet format forces one member per line once an initializer opens out, so a packed layout could never stay put.
- [csharp_max_formal_parameters_on_line](wrapping/csharp_max_formal_parameters_on_line.md) — Chop a parameter list carrying more than this many parameters, regardless of width.
- [csharp_max_invocation_arguments_on_line](wrapping/csharp_max_invocation_arguments_on_line.md) — Chop an argument list carrying more than this many arguments.
- [csharp_max_initializer_elements_on_line](wrapping/csharp_max_initializer_elements_on_line.md) — Chop an initializer carrying more than this many elements.
- [csharp_max_chained_method_calls_on_line](wrapping/csharp_max_chained_method_calls_on_line.md) — Chop a chain carrying more than this many calls, regardless of width. Deterministic mode only.
- [csharp_max_array_initializer_elements_on_line](wrapping/csharp_max_array_initializer_elements_on_line.md) — Chop an array initializer carrying more than this many elements.
- [csharp_wrap_before_declaration_rpar](wrapping/csharp_wrap_before_declaration_rpar.md) — Put a broken parameter list's ) on its own line.
- [csharp_wrap_before_invocation_rpar](wrapping/csharp_wrap_before_invocation_rpar.md) — Put a broken argument list's ) on its own line.
- [csharp_place_method_attribute_on_same_line](wrapping/csharp_place_method_attribute_on_same_line.md) — Where a method's attribute section goes. if_owner_is_single_line joins it when the method fits on one line. Deterministic mode only.
- [csharp_place_field_attribute_on_same_line](wrapping/csharp_place_field_attribute_on_same_line.md) — Where a field's attribute section goes.
- [csharp_place_property_attribute_on_same_line](wrapping/csharp_place_property_attribute_on_same_line.md) — Where a property's attribute section goes.
- [csharp_place_event_attribute_on_same_line](wrapping/csharp_place_event_attribute_on_same_line.md) — Where an event's attribute section goes.

## [Blank Lines](blank-lines/index.md)

- [csharp_keep_blank_lines_in_declarations](blank-lines/csharp_keep_blank_lines_in_declarations.md) — Maximum consecutive blank lines between members.
- [csharp_keep_blank_lines_in_code](blank-lines/csharp_keep_blank_lines_in_code.md) — Maximum consecutive blank lines between statements.
- [csharp_blank_lines_around_invocable](blank-lines/csharp_blank_lines_around_invocable.md) — Blank lines before and after each method or constructor. 0 means leave the author's.
- [csharp_blank_lines_around_local_method](blank-lines/csharp_blank_lines_around_local_method.md) — Blank lines before and after each local function.
- [csharp_blank_lines_around_type](blank-lines/csharp_blank_lines_around_type.md) — Blank lines before and after each type declaration.
- [csharp_blank_lines_around_property](blank-lines/csharp_blank_lines_around_property.md) — Blank lines before and after each property, indexer or event.
- [csharp_blank_lines_around_accessor](blank-lines/csharp_blank_lines_around_accessor.md) — Blank lines between two accessors of the same property, indexer or event.
- [csharp_blank_lines_around_field](blank-lines/csharp_blank_lines_around_field.md) — Blank lines before and after each field.
- [csharp_blank_lines_inside_type](blank-lines/csharp_blank_lines_inside_type.md) — Blank lines below the opening brace and above the closing brace of a type, forced exactly rather than floored.
- [csharp_blank_lines_around_namespace](blank-lines/csharp_blank_lines_around_namespace.md) — Blank lines before and after a namespace declaration.
- [csharp_blank_lines_inside_namespace](blank-lines/csharp_blank_lines_inside_namespace.md) — Blank lines below the opening brace and above the closing brace of a block-scoped namespace, forced exactly rather than floored.
- [csharp_blank_lines_around_region](blank-lines/csharp_blank_lines_around_region.md) — Blank lines before a #region and after its matching #endregion, forced exactly rather than floored.
- [csharp_blank_lines_inside_region](blank-lines/csharp_blank_lines_inside_region.md) — Blank lines below a #region and above its matching #endregion, forced exactly rather than floored.
- [csharp_blank_lines_after_using_list](blank-lines/csharp_blank_lines_after_using_list.md) — Blank lines below the last using directive, forced exactly rather than floored.
- [csharp_blank_lines_after_file_scoped_namespace_directive](blank-lines/csharp_blank_lines_after_file_scoped_namespace_directive.md) — Blank lines after a file-scoped namespace declaration.
- [csharp_blank_lines_before_block_statements](blank-lines/csharp_blank_lines_before_block_statements.md) — Blank lines above an if/while/for/foreach/do/switch/using/lock/try statement.
- [csharp_blank_lines_after_block_statements](blank-lines/csharp_blank_lines_after_block_statements.md) — Blank lines below one of those statements.
- [csharp_blank_lines_before_control_transfer_statements](blank-lines/csharp_blank_lines_before_control_transfer_statements.md) — Blank lines above a return/throw/break/continue/goto/yield statement.
- [csharp_blank_lines_after_control_transfer_statements](blank-lines/csharp_blank_lines_after_control_transfer_statements.md) — Blank lines below one of those statements.
- [csharp_blank_lines_before_case](blank-lines/csharp_blank_lines_before_case.md) — Blank lines above a switch section's first label.
- [csharp_blank_lines_after_case](blank-lines/csharp_blank_lines_after_case.md) — Blank lines below a section's labels, above its first statement.
- [csharp_blank_lines_before_single_line_comment](blank-lines/csharp_blank_lines_before_single_line_comment.md) — Blank lines above a // comment that follows real content.
- [csharp_remove_blank_lines_near_braces_in_declarations](blank-lines/csharp_remove_blank_lines_near_braces_in_declarations.md) — Force no blank line directly under a type/namespace's opening brace or above its closing one.
- [csharp_remove_blank_lines_near_braces_in_code](blank-lines/csharp_remove_blank_lines_near_braces_in_code.md) — The same, for a block's opening and closing braces.

- [csharp_style_expression_bodied_properties](expression-bodies/csharp_style_expression_bodied_properties.md) — Convert an eligible single-getter property to an expression body. IDE0025.

## [Usings](usings/index.md)

- [dotnet_sort_system_directives_first](usings/dotnet_sort_system_directives_first.md) — Put System.* usings before all others.
- [dotnet_separate_import_directive_groups](usings/dotnet_separate_import_directive_groups.md) — Separate groups of usings by first namespace segment with a blank line.
- [csharp_using_directive_placement](usings/csharp_using_directive_placement.md) — Move using directives inside or outside the namespace. IDE0065.

## [Modifiers and Braces](modifiers-and-braces/index.md)

- [csharp_preferred_modifier_order](modifiers-and-braces/csharp_preferred_modifier_order.md) — Reorder modifiers to the specified preference. IDE0036. Applied without a compilation.
- [csharp_prefer_braces](modifiers-and-braces/csharp_prefer_braces.md) — Add braces to unbraced control-flow bodies. IDE0011. Applied without a compilation.

- [csharp_trailing_comma_in_multiline_lists](trailing-commas/csharp_trailing_comma_in_multiline_lists.md) — Add a trailing comma after the last element of a list that breaks across lines.
- [csharp_trailing_comma_in_singleline_lists](trailing-commas/csharp_trailing_comma_in_singleline_lists.md) — Add a trailing comma after the last element even when the list is on one line.

## [Suppression](suppression/index.md)

- [generated_code](suppression/generated_code.md) — Skip this file entirely. Curb never formats files marked as generated.
- [dotnet_diagnostic.ide0055.severity](suppression/dotnet_diagnostic.ide0055.severity.md) — Set this to none to opt a file out of formatting.
- [file_header_template](suppression/file_header_template.md) — Insert or correct a // comment header at the top of the file. Supports {fileName}. IDE0073.
